# v26.0 WP10: Renewable 30-year wave archival — ends active movement, retains all assimilated/converted pops,
# clears timer flags, and sets a 10-year cooldown (renewable after cooldown or via oe_as2.5 Extend Romanization).
# Generated by gen_v260_cul_rel_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.
namespace = oe_identity_expiry

oe_identity_expiry.1 = {
    type = location_event
    title = empty_text
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        culture:oe_tunis_greek_culture = {
            every_movement_in_culture = {
                limit = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_africa_identity_movement }
                destroy_movement = yes
            }
            remove_variable = oe_identity_fixed_30y_scheduled
            remove_variable = oe_identity_start_verified
            remove_variable = oe_identity_start_expired
            remove_variable = oe_identity_timer_v2
            set_variable = { name = oe_identity_wave_cd years = 10 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:ROM }
            c:ROM = {
                remove_variable = oe_rw_africa_romanization_started
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
            c:BYZ = {
                remove_variable = oe_rw_africa_romanization_started
            }
        }
    }
}
